Brand Guidelines
Version 0.1  ·  June 2026

Powering projects
that matter.

This guide defines how MVX Electrical shows up, so every job, post, quote and sign reflects the same thing the work does: reliable, capable, done as promised.

01

Brand Overview

MVX Electrical is a Gold Coast electrical contracting business with 15+ years across commercial, council, construction and residential projects. Owner-operated and locally grounded, with a strong record on blue-chip sites and a deep knowledge of local standards and compliance.

What We Do
Commercial-led electrical contracting, plus council & infrastructure, construction & new builds, and specialist sectors (NDIS & aged care, education, medical/dental fitouts, airport & aviation). Solar & battery, data & comms, air conditioning, fault-finding and maintenance round out the offer. Residential work across the Gold Coast and Northern NSW.
Market Position
The dependable professional. MVX competes on reliability and proven capability, not the lowest price. Builders, project managers and councils choose MVX because the work is delivered as promised, to standard, with minimal disruption. Trusted on sites for the City of Gold Coast, Gold Coast Airport and national brands.
01
Reliable Delivery
Work delivered as promised, consistent workmanship and reliable outcomes, on site and on time.
02
Considered Solutions
A measured, practical approach to problem solving, especially on projects with complex requirements.
03
Quality & Compliance
High standards as standard. Safety and regulatory compliance treated as a baseline, not a selling point.

02

Master Logo

The MVX wordmark is the primary brand asset: "MVX" in a clean geometric sans where the upper-right stroke of the "X" becomes a two-pin electrical plug, with "ELECTRICAL" set in wide tracking beneath. The plug is the signature device, it ties the name straight to the trade.

Logo Construction
  • Two elements: "MVX" in a clean geometric sans, and "ELECTRICAL" in widely-tracked uppercase beneath
  • The plug device forms the upper-right stroke of the "X", it is integral to the mark, not decoration
  • The wordmark is white or black only, white on dark backgrounds, black on light
  • Minimum size: 120px wide digital / 25mm print ⚠️ confirm against final artwork
  • Always use the supplied artwork, never re-typeset or rebuild the logo by hand

Primary, White on Dark

Black, Light Backgrounds

White, over photography (place on a dark area)

03

Logo Rules & Don'ts

Consistent spacing and treatment protect the wordmark. Maintain clear space equal to the height of the "M" on all four sides, and keep the mark on clean, legible backgrounds.

Don't recolour the logo, it is only ever white or black
Don't stretch, condense or distort, always scale proportionally
Don't rotate or angle the logo, it always sits level
Don't add shadows, glows, outlines or other effects to the mark
Don't place the white logo on light or busy backgrounds where it loses contrast, switch to black
Don't crop the wordmark or cut the plug off the "X"

Colour Palette

MVX presents in black and white, charged with a single electric green. Black does the heavy lifting; Primary Green is the spark, reserved for CTAs, key stats and highlights. Dark Green is a supporting accent for small touches and hover states.

Colour Rules
  • Primary Green is an accent, never a background fill, one highlight moment per layout, ≤10%
  • Dark Green (#5E8519) is for small batches only, hover states, secondary accents, depth, not large areas
  • Green sits only on black or white, never on mid or light grey
  • Use the approved hex values, never eyedrop green from a screenshot

06

Imagery

MVX imagery is real work, on real sites, switchboards, solar installs, crew in hi-vis, completed commercial fitouts. Authentic over staged. Natural light, clean and neutral grade.

Photography Style
  • Real worksites and completed jobs, switchboards, data racks, solar & battery, fitouts
  • Crew in hi-vis, tools in hand, work in progress, capability you can see
  • Natural light, clean colour correction, neutral/slightly cool, never oversaturated
  • Tight detail shots and wide site context both work, keep them sharp and high-res
Image Don'ts
  • Cheesy stock electricians grinning at the camera
  • Lightning-storm / "spark" clichés and heavy filters
  • Oversaturated greens that fight the brand accent
  • Low-resolution images in any professional output
  • Competitor branding or unsafe-practice shots visible on site
07

Tone of Voice

MVX talks like a capable tradesperson talking to a builder, calm, direct, no hype. Confidence comes from the work and the track record, not adjectives. We never use fear or urgency to sell.

Reliable
We say what we'll do and do it. Language leads with outcomes, "done as promised", "on site, on time". Steady, not flashy.
Straightforward
Short sentences, plain English. We explain the job clearly without burying clients in technical jargon. Clarity is respect.
Capable
We prove competence with specifics, sectors, scale, compliance, blue-chip sites, never with hype or superlatives.
Writing Rules
  • Lead with the outcome and the reliability, then the detail
  • Use "we" for the crew and "you" for the client's project
  • Reference licences, experience and clients for trust, don't over-claim
  • No fear, no urgency, no pressure tactics, ever
  • No jargon dumps; if a term needs explaining, explain it simply or cut it
Copy in Practice
✓ On-brand
"Commercial fit-out wired and certified, delivered on program, with the site left clean. 15 years on Gold Coast jobs like this one."
✗ Off-brand
"⚡ World-class, #1 electricians! Don't risk a dodgy spark, call NOW before it's too late!!!"
✓ On-brand
"Need solar and battery done properly? We're ARC-accredited and handle it end to end, design, install, compliance."
✗ Off-brand
"Leveraging cutting-edge photovoltaic synergies to revolutionise your energy paradigm."
08

Content & Social

Content leads with proof. Show completed work, then capability, then how MVX works. Channels: Facebook & Instagram. ⚠️ Posting cadence and whether paid ads are in scope to be confirmed.

Content Pillars
  • Completed Work (35%), finished jobs, before/after, the result
  • Capability & Sectors (25%), solar, data, fitouts, infrastructure
  • How We Work (20%), reliability, process, compliance
  • Offer / Contact (10%), quotes, service areas
  • Local & Crew (10%), Gold Coast, the team, behind-the-scenes
Hook Examples
  • "Switchboard upgrade, start to finish 👇", demonstration
  • "Builders on the Gold Coast, keep your electrical on program.", direct callout
  • "15 years. Hundreds of sites. No shortcuts.", credibility
  • "Booking commercial work for spring now.", soft scarcity (never fear)
Trust Assets, use for credibility

09

Brand Rules Summary

A quick-reference checklist for anyone creating MVX Electrical content. When in doubt, check the brand guidelines first.

✓ Always Do
  • Lead with reliability and completed outcomes
  • Keep MVX Green as an accent (~10%) on charcoal or white
  • Use League Gothic for big display headlines only
  • Use Poppins for headings, UI and body
  • Write plainly, builder-to-builder
  • Use real worksite photography
  • Reference licences & blue-chip clients for trust
  • Use approved colour hex values
✗ Never Do
  • Use fear, urgency or pressure selling
  • Fill large areas or backgrounds with green
  • Render the wordmark in green or another typeface
  • Use League Gothic for body or small text
  • Dump technical jargon on non-electricians
  • Over-claim ("best", "#1", "world-class")
  • Use cheesy stock or lightning-storm clichés
  • Recolour, rebuild or re-typeset the logo by hand
Status

Logos, brand colours and company details are locked, and the guide is ready to share as a visual reference. A couple of content choices (posting cadence, paid-ads scope) remain as working defaults and can be confirmed any time.
